title: eschscholzia californica var. compacta
intro: Eschscholzia californica var. compacta, commonly known as the dwarf California poppy or compact California poppy, is a variety of the California poppy plant, known for its compact growth habit and vibrant orange-yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Eschscholzia californica var. compacta include sedation, pain relief, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular natural remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various health conditions.
